arrivals-day.name: Arrivals Day
arrivals-day.description: Build today's arrivals list from their CSV and mark ready versus not-ready using the room-status sheet.

departures-due-out.name: Departures Due Out
departures-due-out.description: List due-outs and planned departures from the in-house export and room status.

folio-exceptions.name: Folio Exceptions
folio-exceptions.description: Read folio PDFs against the tax file and list missing posts, duplicates, tax-off without a cert, comps without a code, and POS mismatches.

group-block-vs-pickup.name: Group Block Vs Pickup
group-block-vs-pickup.description: Compare contracted block rooms to pickup on their group sheet and the arrivals export.

house-count.name: House Count
house-count.description: Restate tonight's house count from their PMS export and in-house list.

night-audit-file-check.name: Night Audit File Check
night-audit-file-check.description: Check that the night-audit packet they dropped has the usual pages versus their PMS export.

no-show-list.name: No Show List
no-show-list.description: Build the no-show list from arrivals that did not check in and from the night-audit PDF if it already coded them.

ooo-and-status.name: Ooo And Status
ooo-and-status.description: List out-of-order and status-board rooms from their status sheet and the PMS export.

tax-exempt-completeness.name: Tax Exempt Completeness
tax-exempt-completeness.description: Compare folios coded tax-exempt to certificates in the tax-file folder.
